customManagers.description: Images Go code runs, such as the Chrome the browser tests drive, named in a string under a renovate comment.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates merge themselves once every check on the PR has passed, the browser tests among them. Renovate merges rather than GitHub's auto-merge, which waits only for required checks, and main requires none.
echo-otel's major version tracks Echo's, so the two move together in one PR, whatever their major version.

The page's libraries, in web/package.json, run in the browser, so a release must be a few days old before it is proposed, long enough for most hijacked ones to be caught and pulled. pnpm refuses younger ones too; see web/pnpm-workspace.yaml.
Alpine's morph plugin must match Alpine's own version, so the two move together in one PR.
htmx 4 is a rewrite, with new event names and a new extension API, which the morph extension in layout.gohtml is written against. Moving to it is a piece of work, not an update.
